Dream Patrol I is a Tutorial Quest that occurs in Ragunna City, Rinascita, [[{{{nation}}}]].

Steps[]

  1. Talk to the strange white cat in Ragunna City

Gameplay Notes[]

  • Completing this quest unlocks the following Nightmare Echoes: Nightmare: Feilian Beringal, Nightmare: Impermanence Heron, Nightmare: Thundering Mephis, Nightmare: Inferno Rider, and Nightmare: Mourning Aix.

Dialogue[]

Strange White Cat: We're finally connected, {Name}. Can you hear me?
Rover: (What is this feeling... is it... the Somnoire?
Strange White Cat: Don't worry, it's just me, the White Cat from the Somnoire. I'm reaching out to you in your dream...
Strange White Cat: There are things best discussed face-to-face. Could you come to Ragunna City if you have the time? I need a favor from you, meow...
Quest Description
You received a message from the white cat of the Somnoire. Go talk to it in Ragunna City.
(Talk to the Strange White Cat)
Strange White Cat: Hello, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍)... This city is quite peculiar, meow. To be honest, it's my first time in Ragunna.
Meow?
Strange White Cat: Ahem... never mind. The reason I contacted you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), is because I sensed your frequency coming from Ragunna.
You are a cat...
Strange White Cat: I am not a mere cat! Ahem, let's set that aside for now. The real reason I contacted you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), is because I sensed your frequency coming from Ragunna.
Strange White Cat: Originally, I couldn't leave the Whining Aix's Mire or collect dreams from other regions due to the restrictons placed upong admin privileges and the Resonance Nexus.
Strange White Cat: Especially in Rinascita, which has been veiled by a network of countless nodes, making any connection impossible... until just recently, when one of its nodes suddenly linked up.
Those special challenge nodes?
Strange White Cat: Exactly. I believe you've unintentionally picked up an unique frequency, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). With the Somnoire obtaining samples from Ragunna, I was finally able to connect with you.
Strange White Cat: Ever since the last incident, I've been working on the Somnoire, getting it to resume the task of dream backup.
Strange White Cat: But I'm completely powerless when it comes to Ragunna's dreams. So, I'd like to ask you to keep completing those challenges, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
Strange White Cat: Most of the Dreamscape Nodes should be directly accessible to you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). Some are special Tacet Discords linked to the Somnoire, while others are corrupted Dreamscape Nexus.
Strange White Cat: However, in the Fagaceae Peninsula and the Penitent's End, the Dreamscape Nodes appear to be veiled by an unknown force.
That sounds complicated...
Strange White Cat: It's truly a headache, meow. Penitent's End is completely shrouded in a thick, eerie fog, and some of the nodes in Thessaleo Fells are shielded by a strange energy.
Strange White Cat: To fully connect the Dreamscape Nodes, these obstructions must be removed. Complete the challenges, and I'll reward you accordingly, meow.
I'll think about it.
Strange White Cat: Alright, then. I'll mark the locations. I'm counting on you, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍).
Strange White Cat: But... something tells me there's more hidden behind the Dreamscape Nodes. (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍), make sure to stay vigilant after completing all the nodes in a region, meow.
(Quest Complete)
Strange White Cat: So the Dreamscape Nexus was taken over by these TDs of obsession...
Strange White Cat: Now the hub seems to have rejoined the dream network, (‍RoverThe player's chosen name for Rover‍). You can try connecting to it, meow.

Tutorials[]

There are 8 Tutorials in Dream Patrol I
Dream Patrol: Dreamscape Node
Dreamscape Node Tutorial
Dreamscape Nodes gather various dream frequencies, each presenting unique challenges based on the dreams and emotions they contain. Clear the Dreamscape Tacet Discords and meet all challenge goals to link the Node to Somnoire. You can interact with the node's core to retry challenges as many times as needed.

Clear the Dreamscape Tacet Discords and meet all challenge goals to link the Node to Somnoire. You can interact with the node's core to retry challenges as many times as needed.
Dream Patrol: Nightmare Node
Nightmare Tacet Discord
Some special Dreamscape Nodes feature enhanced Nightmare Tacet Discords.
Nightmare Tacet Discord

Defeating Nightmares
To complete the challenge, meet all challenge goals within the time limit or defeat the Nightmare Tacet Discords directly.

Dream Patrol: Dreamscape Nexus
Dreamscape Nexus
The Dreamscape Nexus serves as a central point for transmitting frequencies and dreams to Somnoire. Protect it from being destroyed within the time limit. Each defeated wave of enemies reduces the remaining defense time.
Dreamscape Nexus
The Dreamscape Nexus serves as a central point for transmitting frequencies and dreams to Somnoire. Protect it from being destroyed within the time limit. Each defeated wave of enemies reduces the remaining defense time.
Tacet Discords Attracted to Dreamscape Nexus
Beware of Nightmare Tacet Discords in some waves, which can deal greater DMG on the Dreamscape Nexus.
Tacet Discords Attracted to Dreamscape Nexus
Beware of Nightmare Tacet Discords in some waves, which can deal greater DMG on the Dreamscape Nexus.
Dream Patrol: Fae Ignis from Dreamscape
Fae Ignis from Dreamscape
Fae Ignis from the Dreamscape doesn't die when its charge is interrupted. However, when defeated, it will always explode and release fireballs at a faster rate.
Fae Ignis from Dreamscape
Fae Ignis from the Dreamscape doesn't die when its charge is interrupted. However, when defeated, it will always explode and release fireballs at a faster rate.
Dream Patrol: Plushie Echoes
Plushie Squad Synergy
Cuddle Wuddle enters a prep phase of synergy when its HP drops below 80%. During this time, you can interrupt the synergy by dealing DMG equal to 20% of Cuddle Wuddle's max HP or defeating the other Plushies Echoes.
Plushie Squad Synergy
Cuddle Wuddle enters a prep phase of synergy when its HP drops below 80%. During this time, you can interrupt the synergy by dealing DMG equal to 20% of Cuddle Wuddle's max HP or defeating the other Plushies Echoes.
Plushie Squad Dismissed
Once Cuddle Wuddle enters the synergy with other plushies, they will launch Coordinated Attacks. However, if Cuddle Wuddle's HP drops below 30%, the synergy will end, and Cuddle Wuddle will be paralyzed.
Plushie Squad Dismissed
Once Cuddle Wuddle enters the synergy with other plushies, they will launch Coordinated Attacks. However, if Cuddle Wuddle's HP drops below 30%, the synergy will end, and Cuddle Wuddle will be paralyzed.
Dream Patrol: Broken Glass
Broken Glass
Counterattacking the Vitreum Dancer's strikes can break its weapon, which makes the Vitreum Dancer enter an Enraged state and become even more powerful.
Broken Glass
Counterattacking the Vitreum Dancer's strikes can break its weapon, which makes the Vitreum Dancer enter an Enraged state and become even more powerful.
Dream Patrol: Blade of Faith
Blade of Faith
Questless Knights, Diurnus Knights, and Nocturnus Knights can enhance their weapons, indicated by a glowing effect. Counterattack them three times to remove the enhancement, or they will continue to enhance their weapons repeatedly.
Blade of Faith
Questless Knights, Diurnus Knights, and Nocturnus Knights can enhance their weapons, indicated by a glowing effect. Counterattack them three times to remove the enhancement, or they will continue to enhance their weapons repeatedly.
Dream Patrol: Roseshroom
Roseshroom's Weakness
When the Roseshroom charges for shooting a laser, shoot the core at its head to interrupt the charging.
